data.body: AC amendment: Add 9th test section test_ui_classifier_failure_fallthrough to assert DD2 classifier-failure degradation path. The test should set BRAINSTORM_UI_CLASSIFIER_STUB=fail and verify SKILL.md documents that: (a) probe set does NOT fire on classifier failure, (b) degradation notice is logged, (c) ux_probe_fired flag remains unset after failure. Add this as a RED structural assertion (grep SKILL.md for degradation-notice text and fallthrough-to-non-ui on failure). Add .test-index RED marker: plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md: tests/skills/test-brainstorm-ui-intent-detection.sh [test_ui_classifier_failure_fallthrough]
